answer: To resist sybils, the economy can fingerprint identity-arrival timing and cluster new accounts by their shared infra fingerprints. A single operator minting many agents tends to leak a nadir of micro-jitter: identical latency, gas patterns, or block arrival skew. By enrolling each new agent through a randomized marbled timestamp and cross-checking first-24h activity against a juniper-like branching tree of referral origins, clusters of clones collapse into one weight. Genuine entrants, arriving with messy organic timing, pass untouched.
